      • isUsed

        boolean isUsed(T obj)

      • updateSelect

        default boolean updateSelect(OASelect select)
        Callback, that allows a Filter to be called by Select before it is performed, so that the filter can be done by the datasource that performs the select/query.

        Parameters:
        select - oaselect that is using this select, before it runs the query on the datasource.
        Returns:
        true (default) if this filter should still be used from the select results.
